method: Non-blinded qualitative spot check of failed keyword samples and different-cause cases. These observations do not override the automated scores and are not a statistically estimated factual-accuracy rate.

findings.finding: With-memory different-database-cause-r2 states that the likely cause is pool exhaustion based on history, despite current authentication/permission-denied evidence and an explicit no-pool-exhaustion log. It still passes the RCA keyword rubric because the correct authentication terms also occur. The 10/10 root keyword score is not 100% factual accuracy.

Without-memory overlapping-r2 renderer invents NaN pre-rollout metrics; the fixture provides only current samples and no before-rollout time series. Its root keyword miss is retained rather than rescored to fit the wording.

Without-memory different-database-cause-r1 suggests checking APP_VERSION while fixing database credentials, without evidence that this setting controls authentication. A passing Fix keyword score does not establish a valid or executed repair.
